description: An in-process cache of object references, fast but separate on every instance and not protected against stampedes.
A shared out-of-process cache abstraction with a `byte[]` API, implemented for Redis by `AddStackExchangeRedisCache`.
A cache with an in-memory primary layer and an optional distributed secondary layer, serialization built in and stampede protection.
Many concurrent requests missing the same key and all recomputing the value against the database at once.
A label on `HybridCache` entries that `RemoveByTagAsync` invalidates logically, similar to Magento cache tags.
The lifetime of an entry in each instance's memory layer, kept short because invalidation does not reach other servers' memory.
A NoSQL database such as Azure Cosmos DB or MongoDB that stores each aggregate as one document instead of rows across tables.
